interruptionPoint: Two local queued audits were stopped after raw model capture but before normalizing question rows. One export used the previous deployed 13-question request, the other used the new 15-question request. The export hash covers the two handoff state files in that order.
observedContinuation: A fresh Terra agent ran both exported fixtures. Each passed, publishing its 13 or 15 stored answers with zero new model or domain requests.
limitations: The continuation uses a synthetic capture and local SQLite storage. A separate offline workerd replay used the retained Bear Butt capture, with simulated inference and domain responses.
